'''Bene''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
[[File:BeneLightsaber-SWCTP.png|thumb|left|180ox|Bene wielded a blue-bladed lightsaber.]]

In the final days of the war, Padawan Bene was stationed at the Temple when [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], who was secretly the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] Darth Sidious, betrayed the Jedi Order and issued [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] to the Grand Army which, in essence, made it illegal to be a Jedi. As the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] marched into the Temple and opened fire indiscriminately on the Order's members, Bene joined fellow Padawans in protecting the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|youngest Initiates]]. 

[[File:CinDrallig.png|thumb|right|250px|Bene is strangled by Darth Vader.]]
Backed into the [[Room of a Thousand Fountains/Legends|Room of a Thousand Fountains]], Padawans Bene and [[Whie Malreaux/Legends|Whie Malreaux]] stood with [[Battlemaster/Legends|Temple battlemaster]] [[Cin Drallig/Legends|Cin Drallig]] as Sidious' apprentice [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] descended on the group. As Vader slew young Malreaux, the former Jedi reached out with the Force and [[Telekinesis/Legends|strangled]] Bene while cleaving through Master Drallig's shoulder with his lightsaber. Her death, as well as the deaths of the younglings she had died protecting, was recorded on a [[TR4-121|security camera]], and was viewed by Masters [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] when they searched the ruins of the Temple.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

Decades later, after the fall of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and the resurrection of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]], Master [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] viewed the same [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecord]] as it was preserved in the memory banks of [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].<ref name="Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen">''[[Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Bene was played by [[Mousy McCallum]], the daughter of [[prequel trilogy]] producer [[Rick McCallum]].

Bene appears in the first four episodes of ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Yoda Chronicles]]'', voiced by [[Paulina Gillis|Tabitha St. Germain]] In the show, she is depicted as one of the four Padawans taught by Yoda, yet her role can be considered non-canonical within [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] as her confrontation with Vader in "[[Escape from the Jedi Temple]]" contradicts her death in the Room of a Thousand Fountains.
